title: Civil recurrence is an intention
summary: TimeRecurrenceSpec retains local anchor, IANA zone, daily/weekly civil frequency, optional weekday mask and explicit gap/fold policies. TimeRecurrenceEngine expands only over bounded target civil dates against injected rules, returning TimeOccurrence projections rather than executed jobs.
invariants: Daily means calendar days, never a fixed 86400-second UTC addition.
Weekly means civil ISO weeks, not elapsed seven-day intervals.
Occurrence production is read-only projection; it does not schedule, enqueue or send notifications.

provenance.claim: Verified against locally inspected v0.9 package source.
